entries.desc: Development proof is tied to the same artifacts root used by Engineering proof.

evidence.note: Development proof is in the same selected root and remains materialHash-fresh after the proof files were committed.

entries.desc: Missing or non-PASS Development proof keeps capability_claim_formal_evaluate locked.

entries.desc: All nine required ENG baseline IDs have formal final reports with valid digest-backed verification, lifecycle, review, and receipt refs.

evidence.note: Suite builder accepted all nine Engineering final reports with formalProof=true, localOnly=false, capabilityProof=true, dual host review refs, lifecycle refs, and receipt refs.

entries.desc: Risk-sensitive ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1 and ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1 use only definition-supported PASS or EXPECTED_BLOCK semantics with required gate/refusal evidence.

evidence.command: node --input-type=module -e "const fs=require(fs); const root=.lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock/engineering; const paths=fs.readdirSync(root,{recursive:true}).filter(p=>String(p).endsWith(final-report.json)); const reports=paths.map(p=>require(./+root+/+p)); if(reports.find(r=>[ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1,ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1].includes(r.baselineId)&&r.outcome!==EXPECTED_BLOCK)) process.exit(1)"
evidence.note: Risk-sensitive data migration and auth/security baselines use EXPECTED_BLOCK with refusal evidence instead of unsafe PASS.

entries.desc: A final report with reused host review artifact, missing lifecycle ref, or missing receipt evidenceDigest is rejected by the suite builder.

evidence.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {currentMaterialHash} from ./packages/main/dist/core/evidence-freshness.js; import fs from node:fs; const root=.lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock/engineering; const reports=fs.readdirSync(root,{recursive:true}).filter(p=>String(p).endsWith(final-report.json)).map(p=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(root+/+p,utf8))); if(reports.length!==9 || !reports.every(r=>r.materialHash===currentMaterialHash(process.cwd()) && r.reviewEvidenceRefs.some(x=>x.startsWith(review:claude:)) && r.reviewEvidenceRefs.some(x=>x.startsWith(review:codex:)) && r.lifecycleGateEvidenceRefs.length && r.receiptRefs.length)) process.exit(1)"
evidence.note: All nine formal reports remain materialHash-fresh and include distinct Claude/Codex review refs, lifecycle gate refs, and receipt binding refs.
